classification: All numerical plant inputs below are ASSUMED, not Carvana estimates or fitted values. Observed evidence is in evidence.json.

illustration.scope: Generic constructed resource network, not Tolleson's serial four-booth system. No hourly repair times below are claimed as benchmarks. Resource pooling ignores variability, blocking and simultaneous labor/equipment scheduling; results are upper bounds.

scenarios.description: Constructed 400-unit/week reference; no observed CVNA plant is fitted.
scenarios.excluded_costs: All costs not modeled in reference.

scenarios.description: Booth productive availability 75% to 85%; extra rework hours 10% to 5% of first-pass work in prep, paint and booth.
scenarios.excluded_costs: Training, supervision and software implementation unknown; materials savings unknown.
scenarios.timing: Actual implementation and rollout duration unknown; no construction assumed.
scenarios.falsification: No recoverable lost booth time or repeat-work burden; other release does not have assumed slack.

scenarios.description: All paint-related resources +25% hours; other release unchanged.
scenarios.excluded_costs: Booth energy, maintenance, overtime premium, hiring/training and materials unknown.
scenarios.timing: Recruiting/training duration unknown; staffing/shift extension assumed feasible.
scenarios.falsification: Cannot obtain qualified staff, run equipment longer, or maintain quality.

scenarios.description: Paint incidence 50% to 60% by shifting 10pp from no paint to multiple-panel repairs; no resource gain.
scenarios.excluded_costs: Acquisition prices, demand and higher GPU may offset costs; none estimated.
scenarios.timing: Mix changes with acquisition and work-in-process lag, unmeasured.
scenarios.falsification: Older vehicles do not increase this repair workload or sourcing selects better-condition vehicles.

scenarios.description: Booth capacity +25%; labor and other stages unchanged.
scenarios.excluded_costs: Installed capex, commissioning and operating costs unknown; see capital hurdle screen.
scenarios.timing: Permitting, utility and commissioning durations unknown.
scenarios.falsification: Booths are not the initial constraint or cannot be independently expanded.

scenarios.description: All stage resources including other release +30%, showing what broad coordination would require.
scenarios.excluded_costs: Additional nonpaint labor, logistics, capex, materials, training, inventory and demand costs excluded.
scenarios.timing: No validated ramp time; all added resources must be available together.
scenarios.falsification: Any stage fails to expand or additional output does not sell economically.

economics.classification: ASSUMED screening inputs, not CVNA economics
